levels.surface: أبا عبد الله جعفر بن محمد الصادق

notes: «وبالإسناد الأول» stands as written: prev1 to prev12 all open with the same phrase and write no names (has_written_chain false), so no names are inherited
The Imam is written after «سمعت» (rule 5) and transmits from «أبيه» and «جده», so he is a narrator here, not the last link
The last link is «جده», the one who says «قال رسول الله»; the Prophet is not a link
